reverse_direction_root_cause_analysis.finding: verifier A (search/ninfty-verifier-a.mjs) resolves searcher_native/checker_native _ref fields via resolveRef(ref, rootDoc=certificate) at the TOP of runVerifierA (line ~463-464), separately from any native_a/native_b the caller supplies. Lane B fixtures declare these _ref fields with json_pointer (e.g. "/ramification_divisor_on_C_ref") + inline content both present.
reverse_direction_root_cause_analysis.mechanism: resolveRef(ref, rootDoc) attempts json_pointer resolution FIRST whenever ref.json_pointer is present, and returns {malformed:true, reason:"json-pointer-unresolvable"} immediately if that resolution fails -- it does NOT fall back to using ref.inline on its own even though inline is present and independently digest-verifiable. Since rootDoc=certificate has no top-level key matching the pointer path (the path targets a native document, not the certificate object), resolution always fails for lane B fixtures, and the presence of valid inline content is never reached.
reverse_direction_root_cause_analysis.confirmed_by: direct node invocation of ep-lanea-verify-cert.mjs on cert_pos_01.json: this EP script's own resolvedNativeBlob() helper (which DOES pass native_a/native_b as rootDoc) resolves successfully (_ep_ref_resolution: all malformed=false), but runVerifierA's OWN internal top-level check (independent code path, rootDoc=certificate) still reports json-pointer-unresolvable and sets overall_verdict_A=FAIL with provisional_reason_code=schema-invalid.
